program.name: Strength & Size
program.subject: Strength
program.blurb: One heavy day for strength, one volume day for size: the same muscles, two ways.
program.about: Strength and size from the same muscles, trained two ways. The heavy day is few reps of big lifts with long rests; the volume day is supersets with more reps and shorter rests for the pump. Alternating them keeps both qualities climbing. Abs finish every session. Level II asks for heavier weights and Level III adds reps.
